'''Nath Alico''' was an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] went undercover as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ralchio Nervi/Legends|Ralchio Nervi]].
